rows.text: passes dword `+0` of `rcx` to the call at `00430A60`+0x17 and multiplies by `xmm1`, in place, the float at `+4` of each of the first byte-`+0xC` 8-byte entries of the returned pointer; then does the same with the pointer the call at `00430A60`+0x4E returns for dword `+4` and the count in byte `+0xD` (a zero count skips its loop)
